notes: Screen recordings and other clips between 1440p and 4K now come out at 4K under Auto and Enhance, the size the label names, in the same time and at about half the file size; the message when it finishes says how to get 5K instead. Asking for a frame rate now gets the nearest one Crisp can make: “make it 120fps” on 30fps footage now gives exactly 120fps instead of stopping at 90, and “four times the frame rate” now smooths the motion instead of enlarging the picture.
